title: Acid Action Painting (Reload to Resurrect)
summary: A page that genuinely eats its own DOM to nothing, then admits the web can resurrect it perfectly — so it can perform death but never suffer it.
mechanism: Per-visit requestAnimationFrame removes real DOM cells in a chance-shuffled order over a declared finite lifespan, then deletes the picture and the script's own source; reload restores a perfect copy; no storage, no network.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
Jean Tinguely, Homage to New York (1960)
